# TemporalEncodingBias

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
Bias introduced by the choice of spike encoding scheme (e.g., rate vs. temporal coding) that differentially affects accuracy across demographic or environmental subgroups. Highlights that encoding choices, a core iNEST design decision, can systematically disadvantage certain inputs, affecting fairness in edge computing.
